notes: The semi-modular account keeps the root owner as an immutable constructor argument, and the derived address depends on the implementation address.

entryPoint.role: ERC-4337 EntryPoint v0.7 used to validate and execute Perago UserOperations.

entryPointSenderCreator.role: EntryPoint helper used to deploy Perago account senders during UserOperation handling.

factory.role: SMA factory used to derive and deploy Perago Modular Account V2 instances.

semiModularAccountBytecode.role: SMA implementation used when deriving and deploying Perago accounts.

singleSignerValidationModule.role: Validation module Perago installs for the bounded session signer; the root owner uses the semi-modular fallback validation.

allowlistModule.role: Session validation module that allowlists Perago mandate targets and selectors.

nativeTokenLimitModule.role: Session validation module that enforces Perago native-token spend limits.

timeRangeModule.role: Session validation module that enforces Perago mandate expiry.

ownerPaidUserOperation.effect: root owner installed one bounded mandate session

sponsoredUserOperation.effect: session signer executed its single allowlisted call with Alchemy bundler sponsorship
